about: Everything /hov-setup offers, in walkthrough order. detect.mjs reads it to report what is installed, and scripts/check-readme-counts.py reads it to keep the README's plugin lists true. Each name has a section of the same name in SKILL.md, in this order. kind: plugin (on the hov marketplace), other-plugin (on another publisher's marketplace), tool (a program on PATH), paid-skills (a paid skill set and its manager program). helpers are programs an offer needs (named in its needs list) that are not offered on their own. In install, <skill-dir> is the directory holding SKILL.md and <uv> is the uv program the detector found.
